concerns_addressed: P3-INT-001 bleed resolved: reminderCounts now requires a non-null sent_at for SENT rows to be counted as success (apps/api/app/Services/InvoiceMetricsService.php:154-160), so legacy suppressed-as-SENT rows with sent_at null cannot inflate success.

SUPPRESSED rows are excluded from both success and failure: the status predicate is narrowed to FAILED or SENT (InvoiceMetricsService.php:154-161) and the CASE/GROUP BY aggregates category only 'sent'/'failed' (InvoiceMetricsService.php:162-166), ignoring the new suppressed status.

Canonical sent/failed rows still counted correctly: the new cross-service test seeds a SENT row with sent_at and a FAILED row with failed_at, then asserts reminders.success==1 and reminders.failure==1 via GET /api/finance/metrics after suppression (apps/api/tests/Feature/InvoiceReminderSuppressionMetricsTest.php:76-96 and :138-142).

Metrics suppression proof is end-to-end: the test closes the invoice before retry, runs the real 'invoices:reminders' Artisan command, proves SUPPRESSED status with null sent_at/failed_at and zero extra provider calls, then queries /api/finance/metrics and asserts no success/failure increment (InvoiceReminderSuppressionMetricsTest.php:98-142).

Event-window outlet semantics unchanged: the date bounds and outlet scoping predicate are preserved (InvoiceMetricsService.php:150-153 and :163); the metric response keys sent/failed remain (InvoiceMetricsService.php:98-103).
The T7-scoped existing suite still passes: InvoiceMetricsTest (11 filters) plus Analytics guard remain green alongside the new InvoiceReminderSuppressionMetricsTest proof.

strengths: Correction diff on the T7 surface is a targeted 14-line change to reminderCounts only; no other metric group (issued, outstanding, overdue, collection, status breakdown, response shape) is touched, preserving the dashboard contract.
The CASE/CASE-GROUP aggregation is a bounded single-query shape (category + COUNT) consistent with the existing aggregate-by-pluck discipline; no table hydration introduced.
Double guard (SENT-only status predicate plus sent_at NOT NULL) provides defense-in-depth without widening scope: SUPPRESSED exclusion plus legacy-null SENT exclusion.
No function-size regression: reminderCounts remains a short aggregate helper with explicit outlet scope and zero-safe output; the correction adds no new public method or route.
